intermediate.name: Col du Mollendruz
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (2) Col du Mollendruz (144.2 km)

story: After a seven-rider breakaway,marked by a crash that thankfully left all riders able to continue. Caruso attacked solo on the Col du Mollendruz but was chased down by Steinhauser and Cras. The break was caught with 2.5 kilometres remaining, setting up a reduced bunch sprint where Dorian Godon edged out Finn Fisher-Black, with Valentin Paret-Peintre finishing third.
